subject_uz: Ma'muriy bino fasadining shisha va oynalarini yuvish va tozalash xizmati (7500 kv.m)

requirements.summary_uz: Maxsus hududlarda ish olib borish uchun ruxsatnoma talab qilinadi va u 25 ball bilan baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: A permit to work in special (restricted) areas is required and is scored at 25 points.
requirements.quote: Maxsus xududlarda ish olib borish uchun ruxsatnoma

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchining moliyaviy ahvoli 1 yillik bank aylanmasi bilan tasdiqlanadi (25 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Financial standing is shown by one year of bank turnover (25 points).

requirements.summary_uz: Kamida 5 birlik mexanizatsiya vositalari ro'yxati talab qilinadi (25 ball).
requirements.summary_en: A list of at least 5 units of mechanisation equipment is required (25 points).
requirements.quote: 5 бирликдан кам бўлмаган механизация воситалари рўйхати

requirements.summary_uz: Tanlov obyektiga o'xshash obyektlarda ishlash tajribasi talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Experience on objects similar to the subject of the tender is required.

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi qurilish narvoni, yuvish mashinalari, vositalari va anjomlari bilan o'zi jihozlanishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must bring its own ladders, washing machines, detergents and tools.
requirements.quote: kerakli (barcha jixozlar, ya'ni kurilish narvoni, yuvish

requirements.summary_uz: Asosiy shisha fasad bo'limlarini yuvish va tozalash (jami 7500 kv.m, shu jumladan oynalar 1290 kv.m).
requirements.summary_en: Washing and cleaning of main glass facade sections (7,500 sq m in total, including 1,290 sq m of windows).
requirements.quote: Shisha oynali fasadni yuvish va tozalash (asosiy ustki qismi) Ma'muriyat

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat kunning istalgan vaqtida, dam olish va bayram kunlari ham ko'rsatilishi mumkin.
requirements.summary_en: Services may have to be delivered at any time, including weekends, holidays and outside working hours.
requirements.quote: olish kunlari va bayram kunlari, ish vaqtidan tashqari

requirements.summary_en: Service period runs from contract signature until 31 December 2026.
requirements.quote: shartnoma imzolangan vaqtdan boshtab 31 dekabr 2026 yilgacha

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma qiymatining 30 foizi avans, qolgan 70 foizi shartnoma shartlariga muvofiq to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 30% of the contract value is paid in advance, the remaining 70% per contract terms.
requirements.quote: 30 %, qolgan 70 % shartnoma shartlariga muvofiq amalga oshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat ko'rsatuvchi mahsulot namunasini buyurtmachiga tasdiqlatishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The provider must have a product sample approved by the customer.
requirements.quote: Xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi tashkilot maxsulot na'munasini buyurtmachi tomonidan tasdiqlatishi

requirements.summary_uz: Talablar bo'yicha kamchilik topilsa 0-25 ball beriladi va 0 ball olgan ishtirokchi lotdan chetlatiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Where defects are found in the documents, 0-25 points are given and a bidder with 0 points is removed from the lot.
